articles.image_title: Stromausfälle in Kyjiw: Halyna Poluliashchenko, 97, shows her lamp she uses during the blackouts in Kyiv, Ukraine on February 7, 2026. Halyna lives alone on the 12th floor and has not left her apartment for 3 months. She gets help from social workers who visit her. Heating was off for weeks in her apartment and is now coming back. She often doesn't have power and water. Duwing WWII she was taken as Ostarbeiter to Germany. Following a series of devastating Russian missile and drone attacks on Kyiv's and Ukraine's energy infrastructure, many Kyiv and Kyiv region residents lost heating and power for days on end, sometimes water, during the coldest winter weeks with temperatures dropping on some days to -20 degrees Celsius.
